entities.summary: Nora Fatehi is a Canadian singer, dancer and actress based in India. She primarily works in Hindi film and also appeared in Telugu, and Malayalam cinema. Fatehi made her acting debut with the Hindi film Roar: Tigers of the Sundarbans. and gained wider recognition for her dance performances in Indian films. She is regarded as one of the prominent dancers in contemporary Indian cinema.
